hack.root_cause: Zero-Address safeTransferFrom Logic Bug (Cross-Chain Bridge Deposit)
hack.description: Qubit Finance lost $80M when attackers called a deprecated bridge deposit function with a zero-address token, silently "depositing" nothing on Ethereum while minting $185M in collateral on BSC.
